lastCompletedStory.title: Wire auth preflight into runRun before session + sidecar spawn

nextStoryContext: checkClaudeAuth is now fully wired into runRun: it is called after the tmux + orchestrator-file pre-flight checks and BEFORE projectSessionName/setupOrchestratorSession/sidecar spawn. On failure, printError is called and runRun returns 1 without touching tmux. The fake spawn in test/run.test.ts now handles the claude auth status --json probe via the claudeAuth option (default: loggedIn). File-size ceilings updated: run.ts 686, run.test.ts 792. The dry-run path also runs the preflight (recommendation from story notes). If the next story needs to test the preflight independently, import checkClaudeAuth from src/commands/run.ts or directly from src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Already validated in US-001: claude auth status --json exits 0 when logged in, 1 when not; JSON shape includes loggedIn. US-002 wires the existing checkClaudeAuth into runRun; no new external lib surface was introduced.
